about_the_game:
Hallow Maze is a 2.5D metroidvania, with a fast and fluid combat style.The visual style is hand-painted and the artistic style is dark gothic fantasy.

You will have to transform into creatures and use the power of tools to slay enemies, solve puzzles and discover the truth hidden in the depths of the earth.

The game artstyle is hand painted carefully desinged in a 2-5D world. Using the best mechanics of the metroidvania genre that we thought were important both to problem solving and combat.

The combat is fast paced, fluid and full of tools that adapt to the playstyle of the player.

The highlight of the game are the bosses, difficult fights in which you should use all your arsenal and skills.
